say:1:1710361001:0.text: Commander Hendrik! It really is you! It's so wonderful—*cough*—I mean, I'm so surprised to see you here!
say:1:1710361001:0.source_cn: 亨德里克卿！真的是您！太好了，连您也……咳，我是说，您...

say:2:1710361002:1.text: Princess Peggy, I'm relieved to see you safe and well.
say:2:1710361002:1.source_cn: 公主殿下，看到您安然无恙，属下就放心了。

say:3:1710361003:1.text: The Queen and Prince Orion have been deeply worried about you. I was assigned to investigate your disappearance and have mobilized the entire Royal Guard to search for you and the Hall of Ancients.
say:3:1710361003:1.source_cn: 自您失踪后，王后陛下与王子殿下忧心如焚。属下奉命调查此...

say:4:1710361004:0.text: It feels like Cassadee and I have only been here for a short while. Things have escalated so quickly...
say:4:1710361004:0.source_cn: 我和科丝蒂被困在这里，感觉不过才几刻钟而已。外面的动静...

say:5:1710361005:1.text: A short while? After you went missing, I was notified of Alaine's disappearance, and then I went to the Evergreen Exhibition, where I was trapped...
say:5:1710361005:1.source_cn: 几刻钟？殿下，从您失踪，到属下接到阿莱茵女士失踪的报告...

say:6:1710361006:1.text: It couldn't have been just a short while.
say:6:1710361006:1.source_cn: 这期间流逝的时间，绝不仅仅是几刻钟。

say:8:1710361007:1.text: Commander Hendrik, did you encounter anything unusual before being moved here?
say:8:1710361007:1.source_cn: 亨德里克司令，您在被传送此处前有什么异常情况吗？

say:9:1710361008:1.text: I was ambushed in the Evergreen Exhibition.
say:9:1710361008:1.source_cn: 没错。我在调查冬青展览馆的最深处时，遭遇了埋伏。

say:10:1710361009:1.text: A set of <style="highlight">ancient magic armor</style> in the collection suddenly came to life and attacked me.
say:10:1710361009:1.source_cn: 那是馆藏的一具<style=highlight>古代魔...

say:11:1710361010:1.text: I felt disoriented while engaging the armor, and before I knew it, I was here. That armor must have carried some sort of teleportation magic.
say:11:1710361010:1.source_cn: 就在我与它缠斗的过程中，突然感到一阵恍惚，随后人就已经...

say:13:1710361011:1.text: Commander Hendrik, allow me to clarify! I've spent three years studying that armor, and I can assure you its runes only govern defense and counterattacks. It has absolutely no teleportation capabilities.
say:13:1710361011:1.source_cn: 亨德里克司令，容我在此澄清！那具铠甲我研究了整整三年，...

say:14:1710361012:1.text: You're here too, Alaine! If the teleportation had nothing to do with the armor...
say:14:1710361012:1.source_cn: 阿莱茵馆长？您也在。如果不是盔甲，而我当时又确实在与它...

say:15:1710361013:1.text: Then it must've happened to me when I wasn't aware.
say:15:1710361013:1.source_cn: 那我就是在毫无察觉的情况下中招了。

say:17:1710361014:1.text: Some unknown method of teleportation, coupled with this strange discrepancy in the flow of time...
say:17:1710361014:1.source_cn: 未知的传送手段，再加上这诡异的时间流速差……

say:18:1710361015:1.text: We're in an extremely vulnerable position. Not only is magic weaker here, but the <style="highlight">flow of time</style> is distorted to some extent.
say:18:1710361015:1.source_cn: 殿下，我们处于极度的被动中。这里不仅隔绝了魔法通讯，甚...

say:19:1710361016:1.text: Something's very wrong here! We need to get out of here quickly!
say:19:1710361016:1.source_cn: 这里有太多古怪了！我们不能在圣古堂里闲庭信步了，得赶快离开！

say:20:1710361017:1.text: Commander Hendrik, we're now heading to a secret passage known only to the royal family.
say:20:1710361017:1.source_cn: 亨德里克卿，我们先前往只有王室成员才知道的秘密通道吧。

say:21:1710361018:1.text: I need you to bring up the rear to keep everyone safe.
say:21:1710361018:1.source_cn: 这里还有不少被卷进来的无辜者，我需要您殿后，护卫队伍的安全。

say:22:1710361019:1.text: I'll stay at the back, Your Highness. Please lead the way.
say:22:1710361019:1.source_cn: 遵命，公主殿下。属下会守住后方。请殿下带路吧。
